column1: # The real cities in the builders' home zones: Natural Earth's 1:10m populated places (public domain,
# https://www.naturalearthdata.com), from nvkelso/natural-earth-vector at ca96624a, geojson/ne_10m_populated_places.geojson:
# each place whose TIMEZONE is a home zone and whose ISO_A2 is that zone's country. Where TIMEZONE is empty the zone
# is the one the place's country or state keeps (New South Wales but Goondiwindi, which is in Queensland; California and
# Idaho's Wallace; Connecticut, Pennsylvania, North Carolina and Florida's Jacksonville; all of GB, IN and JP).
# population is POP_MAX, and area_km2 MIN_AREAKM, the urban core's area (0 where the source gives none).
